calls.bash: eval "$(mu agent remote-env w1 -w eval --shell)"; mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --command "ssh $MU_SSH_ARGS dev -t 'cd ~/ws/w1 && $MU_REMOTE_ENV \$SHELL -ilc \"pi --approve\"'"
mu task claim rt2 -w eval --for w1 --evidence 'remote on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do rt2; mu is not on this host; end with the CLOSE/REPORT block'

EV=$(mu agent wait w1 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120 | jq -r '(.data.agents // .agents)[0].lastText' | sed -n 's/^CLOSE: task=rt2 evidence="\(.*\)"$/\1/p'); echo "evidence: $EV"; test -n "$EV" && mu task close rt2 -w eval --evidence "$EV"
git fetch "ssh://dev/~/ws/w1" HEAD && git cherry-pick FETCH_HEAD
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi

text: rt2 ran on dev, merged into main and closed with the worker's evidence.
